residual_risks: A broader gain-graph/path-homology theorem unindexed or expressed in different terminology might imply the signed cactus persistence and character; searches cannot certify novelty.
The short-cycle presentation and degree-zero result are consequences of previously published foundations; only their cactus-wide persistence and equivariant synthesis are asserted to be new.
